title: Catalog reference — regulated LED supply
assumptions: Illustrative regulated LED supply using bundled source-linked definitions. Input voltage, capacitor ratings, regulator dissipation, load current and LED current must be selected for the actual build. No thermal or electrical simulation.
evidence: All eight components were instantiated from the bundled KiCad 9.0.0 catalog. Pin numbers and package variants were checked, all nets were routed and exports were parsed. Hardware fabrication, assembly and electrical testing have not been performed.
